title: International PhD studentships
field: All disciplines offered for PhD study at the University of Reading
about: The University of Reading offers International PhD studentships for an October 2027 start to applicants eligible for international fees. Applicants apply for a PhD place by 15 January 2027; Schools nominate candidates and a university panel decides around the end of March.
requirements: Applicants must be eligible for International fees
Apply for a PhD place by 15 January 2027 and enter "International Research Studentship Competition" in the scholarship section
Off-campus/distance applicants receive tuition fees and the training and development allowance only, with no stipend
Each School nominates one candidate; a university-wide panel decides around the end of March 2027

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: Seniority "Doctoral" / "Apply for a PhD place by 15 January 2027" → "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."

Field "All disciplines offered for PhD study at the University of Reading" → "Improve academic workflows involving writing support, data exploration, note organization, document analysis, and research knowledge management."
Doctoral research context → "Apply responsible practices for verification, attribution, citation awareness, confidentiality, and academic integrity when using AI in research activities."
